operation.description:
Gets the end-of-life schedule for a specific runner version in a repository. Returns the runner version
and the dates when registration and runtime support will end.

Authenticated users must have admin access to the repository to use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.

parameters.description: The runner version to look up.
parameters.name: version

registration_deprecates_at.description: The date after which this runner version can no longer register. Null if no schedule is set.

runtime_deprecates_at.description: The date after which jobs will no longer be dispatched to runners on this version.

operation.summary: Get runner version end-of-life schedule for a repository

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo
